releaseNotes:
Tap the three in your journal and each one answers in its own way — and differently again if you keep tapping, or hold your finger there.

The kitchen stirs while a recipe is being written, a fridge photo makes somebody jump, and a finished recipe gets tasted. Log a workout and somebody runs the park path and comes back out of breath.

The month, the medals and the porch all react too, charts arrive instead of appearing, and the app is smaller and quicker.
